rows.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN defendant IN ('Minister for Immigration and Citizenship', 'Minister for Immigration and Multicultural Affairs', 'Minister for Immigration and Multicultural and Indigenous Affairs', 'Commissioner of Taxation') THEN defendant WHEN defendant <> '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE defendant <> '' GROUP BY applicant_nation, verdict_family
